name: NegotiationArena
description: NegotiationArena is a flexible framework for evaluating and probing the negotiation abilities of LLM agents. It implements three scenario types: ultimatum games (allocating shared resources), trading games (aggregating resources), and price negotiations (buying/selling goods), quantifying both rational and irrational negotiation behaviors.
reputation: Published at ICML 2024; demonstrates that strategic behaviors like pretending to be desperate can improve payoffs by 20%
notes: GPT-4 identified as overall best negotiator; LLMs exhibit irrational behaviors similar to humans; open-source platform available on GitHub.
